**CRITICAL**: This project uses **UV** for all Python operations. Never use `python -m`, `pip install`, or `python script.py` directly.
**Never guess** - verify with official docs (Context7 MCP, WebFetch, WebSearch) before implementation.
Check confidence BEFORE starting: ≥90% proceed, 70-89% present alternatives, <70% ask questions.
Always prefer MCP tools over speculation for documentation/research.
**CRITICAL**: When running multiple Claude Code sessions in parallel, use `git worktree` to avoid conflicts.
**⚠️ NOT IMPLEMENTED**: The TypeScript plugin system described below does not exist in v4.1.9.
**What Does NOT Work** (yet): `.claude-plugin/` directory auto-detection; `/plugin marketplace add`; `/plugin install superclaude`; `make build-plugin` (planned but not functional).

Commands: `uv run pytest`; `uv run pytest tests/pm_agent/`; `uv pip install package`; `uv run python script.py`; `make dev`; `make verify`; `make test`; `uv run pytest tests/pm_agent/ -v`; `uv run pytest tests/test_file.py -v`; `uv run pytest -m confidence_check`; `uv run pytest --cov=superclaude`; `make lint`; `make format`; `make doctor`; `make build-plugin`; `make sync-plugin-repo`; `make clean`; `pipx install superclaude && superclaude install`; `git checkout -b feature/your-feature`; `git commit -m "feat: description"`; `git worktree add ../SuperClaude_Framework-integration integration`; `git worktree add ../SuperClaude_Framework-feature feature/pm-agent`; `git worktree remove ../SuperClaude_Framework-integration`.
